thread.title: Apple's 'defining moment' is here — and it may mean moving past the iPhone (AAPL)

author: Goobee
title: Apple's 'defining moment' is here — and it may mean moving past the iPhone (AAPL)
text: in General Apple's slow quarter for iPhone sales may spell trouble ahead for the smartphone.The age of double-digit growth in iPhone sales may be nearing its end, according to UBS Analyst Steven Milunovich. Apple - Ways - Base - Software - Accessories But Apple has found ways to monetize its installed base through software and new accessories.See Apple's stock price in real time here. Era - Sales - Growth - IPhone - End The era of double-digit sales growth for the iPhone may be nearing its end.Apple is reaching a "defining moment," according to UBS Analyst Steven Milunovich, as demand for the iPhone — the device which catapulted the smartphone revolution and the company's earnings growth — slowed this past quarter. The slowdown suggests that the iPhone" supercycle" is dead. IPhone - Milunovich - Mature - IPhone - Categories "The iPhone is now mature," Milunovich wrote. "A mature iPhone means that other categories, especially services and other products, will become material to growth."The supercycle is marked by a fresh wave of customers and upgrades for a new device, like the iPhone X, which did not materialize in the past quarter.
